reviews.summary: There is no graph capture in this implementation. A single width is chosen from the rank-local average row length; if that average is at least 512, all local rows use the long-row kernel, otherwise all use the selected width-4/8/16/32 kernel. The timed loop repeats the selected launch once per requested iteration, then checks and synchronizes. This is not a per-row split between long and standard kernels.
